summary: Tested line-level discount (remise) functionality in SR Rénovation QuoteForm. All 5 required scenarios verified: (1) amount discount 100€ on qty=2 x 500€ service → line total 900€, form totals show 'Total TTC (avant remises): 1000€' / 'Total remises: -100€' / 'Total Option 1: 900€', PDF preview shows (-100.00 €) indicator on service row and 'Total avant remises: 1000€' / 'Remise: -100€' / 'TOTAL NET (TTC): 900€'. (2) Percent discount 10% on same service → line total 900€, PDF shows (-10%) indicator with same correct totals. (3) No discount → total displays normally without 'Total avant remises' section in form or PDF. All 3 scenarios PASS.

test_results.TEST_2_form_totals_with_amount_discount: PASS — 'Total TTC (avant remises): 1000.00 €', 'Total remises: -100.00 €', 'Total Option 1 (TTC): 900.00 €' all shown correctly
test_results.TEST_3_pdf_preview_service_row_indicator: PASS — '(-100.00 €)' indicator shown on service row in PDF preview
test_results.TEST_4_pdf_preview_totals_section_amount: PASS — 'Total avant remises: 1000.00 €', 'Remise: -100.00 €', 'TOTAL NET (TTC): 900.00 €' shown in PDF preview
test_results.TEST_5_percent_discount_10pct: PASS — line total 900.00, PDF shows (-10%) indicator on service row, totals show 'Total avant remises: 1000.00 €', 'Remise: -100.00 €', 'TOTAL NET (TTC): 900.00 €'
test_results.TEST_6_no_discount_normal_display: PASS — no 'Total avant remises' shown in form or PDF, 'TOTAL NET (TTC): 1000.00 €' displayed correctly

features_verified: ✓ updateService() correctly recalculates s[i].total = qty*price - remise (amount or %) in real time
✓ totals1 useMemo: total_brut = gross before line discounts, remises_lignes = sum of line discounts, remise_totale = remisesLignes + remiseGlobale, all passed to previewDoc via ...totals1 spread
✓ PDFPreview.js ServicesTable: remise_type='amount' → shows (-100.00 €); remise_type='percent' → shows (-10%)
✓ PDFPreview.js TotalsSection: effectiveRemise = remiseTotale (when defined) correctly uses line discounts; 'Total avant remises' + 'Remise' row shown when effectiveRemise > 0
✓ TotalsSection: No 'Total avant remises' section when effectiveRemise = 0 (no discount scenario)
✓ QuoteForm form totals: 'Total TTC (avant remises)' and 'Total remises' shown only when remise_totale > 0
✓ previewDoc spread ...totals1 correctly passes remise_totale and total_brut to PDF renderer
critical_code_review_comments: All discount features working correctly. No issues found.
Note from iteration_13: QuoteForm.js is 1284 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Future refactor into ServiceRow, TotalsDisplay, ProfileSelector sub-components would improve maintainability.

Note: When switching remise_type from 'percent' to 'amount' in the select, the remise_montant resets to 0 on mobile layout (line 98) but desktop layout (line 178) does not reset — minor inconsistency but no functional impact since the visible inputs are the desktop ones.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14: ALL line-level remise scenarios verified. Amount (€) and percent (%) discounts working end-to-end in form AND PDF preview. Key selectors: service-row-1-0 contains 7 inputs (0-2 hidden mobile, 3=qty visible, 4=unit_price visible, 5=discount visible, 6=readOnly total visible) and 4 selects (0-1 hidden mobile, 2=unit visible, 3=remise_type visible). Test flow: PIN 0330 → /quotes/new → add service → set qty/price → change remise_type select to 'amount' or leave 'percent' → set discount value → verify Total input + form totals section + PDF preview text. No discrepancies found between QuoteForm totals and PDFPreview rendering.
